response.edited_text: I finally sorted the drawer where every spare cable goes to become a mystery. Three of them belong to devices I no longer own. One probably belongs to the desk lamp, although I have not proved that yet. I put the useful ones in a biscuit tin and wrote “CABLES, PROBABLY” on the lid. So now I have a bit more room on my desk. That is the only sentence in this email that sounds like it is wearing a tie. Anyway, I found the charger you were looking for. It has the orange tape around one end, just as you described. I can leave it at your place tomorrow, or you can collect it when you come over for lunch.
